why: Restores the shipped rule issue #323 replaced, in its most complete form: the Main Menu button reachable only from Pause. The measured consequence is a player who runs out of campaign lives having exactly ONE control on screen, and that control restarts the level (`landOnCampaignBoard`, loop.ts) rather than leaving it -- so the menu is reachable only by playing again, pausing, and quitting from there. `back` is no help: route-host.ts's menu-action handler acts on `back` only while `sm.isPaused`. The panel still renders correctly under this mutation, which is why it needs a case that enumerates the REACHABLE controls rather than one that checks the panel appeared.
